safety_notes: This diagnostic firmware is separate from all QR Host releases.
The development USB-C VBUS and USB-A/5V/VSYS share a board supply net; never connect PC power and the external supply simultaneously without verified isolation.

Deployment was performed after a verified full-flash backup. UART boot and USB_HOST_READY were observed on 2026-11-20. R13 workmanship photos, external-power path acceptance, and USB CDC Host hardware acceptance remain pending.
The native USB CDC device interface is disabled in this diagnostic firmware; loss of the COM port after reboot is expected. Use the separate TX-only diagnostic UART for runtime evidence.
